subject.title: clawhub install does not register skill hooks automatically

question: Should skill installation support OpenClaw hook registration, and what declaration, scanner disclosure, event restrictions, and user consent must gate activation?
rationale: The current product separates text-bundle skill installation from executable plugin installation, so hook activation expands a security boundary that repository vision requires to remain explicit and operator-controlled.

options.title: Explicit consent handoff
options.body: Detect a declared hook capability, display its scan and permission details, and require confirmation before native OpenClaw registration.

options.title: Keep installs separate
options.body: Preserve explicit plugin installation and add a clear post-install warning with the exact registration command for hook-bearing skills.

options.title: Trusted-tier automation
options.body: Permit automatic registration only for a narrowly defined vetted or official package tier with documented restrictions.

recommendation.title: Explicit consent handoff
recommendation.body: Detect a declared hook capability, display its scan and permission details, and require confirmation before native OpenClaw registration.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across the exact install, scanner, release, and documentation surfaces involved.
